title: Applications of AI in Astrophysics and Cosmology
level: PhD students, postdocs and junior faculty
about: ICTS workshop, 29 March to 9 April 2027 at ICTS Bengaluru, for early-career researchers in astrophysics, cosmology, data science or AI/ML. Applications close 15 January 2027.
requirements: Early-career researchers in astrophysics, cosmology, data science or AI/ML; exceptionally qualified Master's/Bachelor's students also considered

upskill.name: Machine Learning - Foundations & Methods I
why: Qualification "Early-career researchers in astrophysics, cosmology, data science or AI/ML" → objective "Supervised learning: classification, regression, decision trees, SVMs, ensemble methods"
Field "Astrophysics, cosmology, AI/ML" → objective "Unsupervised learning: clustering (k-means, DBSCAN), dimensionality reduction (PCA, t-SNE, UMAP)"
